sources.title: Cramming More Components onto Integrated Circuits
sources.use: Historical analogy for exponential semiconductor-component trends.
sources.nonclaim: The paper does not establish an intelligence-doubling law, AGI timeline, price law, or welfare result.

sources.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
sources.use: Evidence that measured model loss can exhibit compute/data/model scaling relationships.
sources.nonclaim: Loss scaling on the studied tasks is not a law of general intelligence, autonomous returns, prices, or alignment.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index Handbook of Methods
sources.use: Boundary that a price index is a defined basket/weight construction rather than a synonym for all prices.
sources.nonclaim: The research basket is not represented as the official CPI.

sources.title: Automation and New Tasks: How Technology Displaces and Reinstates Labor
sources.use: Task-based boundary between productivity, displacement, new tasks, wages, and distribution.
sources.nonclaim: Productivity growth is not treated as automatic household pass-through or universal benefit.

sources.title: The Debt-Deflation Theory of Great Depressions
sources.use: Motivation for an explicit nominal-debt guardrail when discussing deflation.
sources.nonclaim: The historical theory is not asserted to identify the net effect of this hypothetical mechanism.
